title: Example project
overview: A small example showing how a project becomes an ordered milestone.

milestone.title: Example project
milestone.description: Published from a confirmed milestone plan.

assumptions: The repository and required GitHub credentials are configured for dn.

issues.title: Define the project contract
issues.body:
## Overview

Document the contract needed by the implementation issues.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Contract is documented and reviewed.
- [ ] Required inputs and outputs are explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Required inputs and outputs are explicit.

issues.title: Implement the project contract
issues.body:
## Overview

Implement the contract from the prerequisite issue.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Implementation satisfies the documented contract.
- [ ] Automated tests cover the supported behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover the supported behavior.
